_note: Preferred gear per swarm role and grade: { role: { grade: { slot: itemId, _weapon: rule } } }. Slots are edited on the dashboard Gear tab; read live by swarm.js planUpgrades (no deploy for the data). _weapon (file only, user decision 2026-10-07 for destroyers): type/two limit every automatic weapon pick, sa = wanted special abilities in order (the soul crystal target follows Dashboard/server.js soulWants), real 'crystal' = buy the REAL weapon only once the soul crystal for it is ready (until then the Common twin: same P.Atk/crit, no S.A. possible). See docs/plan/destroyer_build.md.

_weapon.why: C (lvl 40-51): 2h sword = base crit 8 (blunt 4). Berserker Blade - Focus: red Soul Crystal stage 8 + 555 Gemstone C + 1,665,000 adena at Pushkin (multisell 1005).

B (52+): crit rate is capped (500) with Rsk. Focus + Song of Hunter + Improved Critical Attack, so crit DAMAGE (Zealot blunt x2.0) wins. Star Buster - Rsk. Focus: blue stage 10 + 339 Gemstone B + 3,390,000 adena. Not sold in Giran.
A: Behemoth's Tuning Fork - Focus (red stage 12 + 157 Gemstone A); alternative Doom Crusher - Rsk. Haste (blue stage 12). Not sold in Giran.
S: Dynasty Crusher - Rsk. Focus (blue stage 14 + 285 Gemstone S; in H5 Dynasty is S80 gear). Not sold in Giran.
